title: mypy crashes at some forward references
body:
### comments

There's no error if the line `Element = Union['Node', 'Tree']` follows the line `Node = NamedTuple('Node', [('ref', int)])`.

Latest version of mypy is installed from github.

```
> mypy --version
mypy 0.3.1
```
### code

```
from typing import List, NamedTuple, Union

Element = Union['Node', 'Tree']
Node = NamedTuple('Node', [('ref', int)])


class Tree(object):
    def __init__(self, data: List[Element]) -> None:
        self.content = data

    def swap(self, i: int, j: int) -> None:
        self.content[i], self.content[j] = self.content[j], self.content[i]
```
